title: Requirement and Mission Adjudication
summary: Expose eighteen requirement dockets and six dependent mission dockets with an enforceable requirement-before-mission decision sequence.
record_scope: Append-only Phase 165–172 evidence-to-publication overlay over immutable Phase 156 and Phase 164 validation receipts.
publication_boundaries: This is an append-only operating and content layer over the immutable Phase 156 and Phase 164 receipts; it does not rewrite either validated baseline.
Only evidence checks lawful on or before 2026-09-01 may carry a decision. Later September and October outcomes remain null until their recorded dates.

Candidate sources, planned capacity, service availability, offers, forecasts, and adjacent facts do not substitute for the exact observation, authority, period, method, and denominator required by a gate.
No owner decision, project or place stage, admitted longitudinal series, causal result, score, rank, repository publication, hosted deployment, or v1 promotion is inferred.

adjudication_dockets.rejection_test: Reject portals, discovery rails, subject adjacency, forecasts represented as observations, stage substitution, entity mismatch, and denominator mismatch.
adjudication_dockets.sequencing_rule: Requirement decisions are independent and must bind the exact candidate-set digest.

adjudication_dockets.title: Advanced Manufacturing: outcome research mission
adjudication_dockets.state: Held — requirement prerequisites and owner decision pending
adjudication_dockets.prerequisite_state: Not satisfied — one or more requirement dispositions remain nonterminal
adjudication_dockets.acceptance_test: Every required requirement must have a terminal owner disposition before a mission conclusion can be issued.
adjudication_dockets.rejection_test: Do not infer a mission conclusion from source adjacency, candidate discovery, or a partial requirement set.
adjudication_dockets.sequencing_rule: A mission decision is invalid until every listed prerequisite requirement decision is terminal and receipt-bound.
adjudication_dockets.next_action: Complete all three owner adjudications, then apply the stored mission completion rule without converting partial context into a complete answer.
